chapters.text:
Prices
The shopkeeper kept a careful ledger of everything she sold.
Ledger
Item	Cost
Tea	3.50
Coffee with milk	12.00
Total 15.50
At the end of the day the ledger balanced, and the shopkeeper was content.
I.	Down the Rabbit-Hole, in which Alice follows a rabbit and falls a very long way
II.	The Pool of Tears
Nothing else happened, which was exactly how the shopkeeper liked her evenings.
